User requirement:
Pull Request Merge Access

A user may merge a pull request only if the user holds the maintainer role, is not the pull request’s author, and is using the VPN. The pull request must have at least one approval, and its target branch name must begin with “hotfix/”.

These are the only permissions: merging is allowed when all these requirements are met; otherwise it is denied, and no other actions are permitted.

Candidate policy:
permit (principal is User, action == Action::"mergePullRequest", resource is PullRequest)
when { (((principal.roles.contains(Role::"Maintainer"))) && (principal != resource.author) && ((resource.approvalCount >= 1)) && (context.onVpn)) };
